user_reviews.Description:
We stayed at the Hilton in a king deluxe room, for 3 adults. There was a king bed, and a roll out bed which had a proper mattress on it and was extremely comfy.
The hotel itself if immaculate! The staff are super friendly, and the house keeping staff came in every day and changed our bedding and towels (which is not something we expected but it was lovely to come home each day to an extremely clean room!). The room was spacious with a sofa, television, a desk and tea/coffee. We had no problems asking for  extras, staff were happy to help.

The shower is a bath/shower so just be aware if you need to ask for an accessible room - but the water pressure is great! There is shampoo/conditioner/body wash provided if needed.

We used the pool facilities which were clean and welcomed after long days of walking, and the spa staff were super friendly. We were provided with pool towels each time.

The location is fantastic, the square just outside the hotel has bar facilities set up so we did have a few drinks with the most stunning views of the cathedrals. We used the hop on hop off bus a few days which conveniently has a stop about a minutes walk away from the hotel.
There is also a Lidl about a 5 minute walk away, so we did stop by and get a few snacks and a bottle of Prosecco for the room (the room has champagne flutes).

All in all it was a fantastic hotel in a perfect location and we will definitely be returning!

user_reviews.Name: Simon Hart
user_reviews.Description:
This hotel is very large and corporate but is in a great location (near Alexanderplatz station for both S-bahn and U-bahn).
Within 500m of this hotel there are a huge selection of shopping and dining options, some, literally 10yds away.
So, for a weekend trip this is super for convenience.
The service for the price paid is, at best, lacklustre.
As with many hotels now, you have to 'book' to have your room serviced, and even then in our experience, that is carried out a day late.
They did not refresh the water or the coffee in our room, even when it was serviced and when we reported our fridge as not working, the reception response was "we were very lucky to have a fridge". In all fairness, it was fixed the following day, only to fail again the subsequent day.
The shower fluctuates between cool and extremely hot, irrespective of fiddling with the controls.
The towels are a very long way from being fluffy and luxurious. More abrasive and threadbare tbh.
I expected to pay a premium due to the location and the generous room size, however, I really didn't feel the service matched the price tag.
In summary, great central location, comfortable rooms and a reasonably priced bar.
This hotel definitely lacks top notch service throughout - at best it's simply functional.

user_reviews.Name: Donna Liggins
user_reviews.Description:
The Park Inn Hotel is massive and tall.  They seem to have specialized in hosting large "touristy" travel groups. There are also business travellers and regular tourists too. Therefore, at crunch times morning and weekends, the lines to enter the breakfast buffet can be long and the tables filled. No worries however, because they have a second "restaurant" area on the second floor for the overflow. Those working at the reception were very friendly and did their best to assit me and my guests. The rooms were comfortable and mid-sized. The mattresses were firm but comfortable. The rooms feature a separate toilet/shower/sink area, closed off with a sort opaque plexiglass/glass, but not in an enclosed room per se. For a few nights stay on your own this works. I'm not sure if it would still be comfortable after a week.

The hotel itself is in the middle of Alexanderplatz. If you are looking for a quiet area and no crowds, this is NOTthe place for you. It is great if you want to be in the middle of the action, with shops, buskers, lots of people milling about. It is also very close to all kinds of public transportation.

Overall it was a comfortable and modern stay and if I would pick it again.

user_reviews.Name: Mark mccool
user_reviews.Description:
The Mercure Hotel Berlin Wittenbergplatz benefits greatly from its location. Being right beside Wittenbergplatz, close to KaDeWe, Kurfürstendamm, the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church and excellent public transport links, makes it a very convenient base for exploring Berlin. The surrounding area feels safe, vibrant and has plenty of shops, restaurants and cafés nearby.

The hotel itself is clean, well maintained and has a stylish fashion-inspired design theme, which fits the area well. The lobby and public areas are attractive, and the staff were pleasant and helpful.

However, the overall experience was a little underwhelming for a 4-star hotel. The room was clean and functional, but it did not feel particularly luxurious or cosy. Given the hotel’s claims of a stylish and modern experience, I expected a little more comfort and some updated features. One noticeable omission was the lack of a smart TV, meaning no easy access to streaming services such as Netflix, which many travellers now expect as standard.

Overall, this is a perfectly good hotel with a fantastic location, and the cleanliness and convenience are definite positives. However, the rooms and facilities do not quite deliver the premium 4-star feeling that the marketing suggests. A good choice if location is your priority, but there are probably hotels nearby that offer a more comfortable and modern experience for a similar price.

Stayed at Hotel ZOE by AMANO for two nights.
The location is excellent, right in the heart of Berlin and within easy walking distance of trains, shopping, and plenty of great restaurants. The rooftop bar is a lovely place to unwind, and the hotel restaurant serves a great breakfast. The dining area is beautiful and one of the standout features of the property.
Unfortunately, the air conditioning in our room was not functioning properly. The system is centrally ducted, and despite following the advice provided by staff, there was no improvement. The room temperature remained around 35°C, making it extremely uncomfortable, particularly at night.
As a result, our two-night stay was largely sleep deprived due to the excessive heat in the room. When we raised the issue with staff, we followed their suggested steps, but nothing changed and we felt our concerns were largely dismissed rather than properly addressed.
The rooms are also very small, with virtually no storage space for luggage, clothing, or personal items, which made the stay less comfortable.
Overall, the location, breakfast, beautiful dining area, and rooftop bar were excellent, but the ineffective air conditioning, lack of sleep, limited storage space, and poor handling of our concerns significantly impacted our experience.

user_reviews.Name: H5537LQdavidr
user_reviews.Description: The Hotel is situated on Potsdamer Platz which has very good transport connections, but is also conveniently placed for sightseeing on foot - the Brandenburg Gate is just a short walk away.  On arrival at the hotel, my wife and I were checked in quickly and efficiently by the friendly Receptionist.  As we were shown to the lift to access our room on the ninth floor (of ten), we passed through the stunning atrium which gives the hotel a light and spacious feeling..  Our room was very well appointed and had beautiful lighting.  The room was quiet and the bed was very comfortable.  The bathroom was also furnished well and had an excellent rain shower.  As we had booked a Club Room, this granted us access to the Executive Lounge on the tenth floor with its fabulous views of Berlin, including the famous Berlin TV Tower.  Here we were treated each morning to a variety of hot and cold breakfast offerings to suit every taste.  The Lounge remained accessible throughout the day, during which time tea, coffee, soft drinks and simple snacks were available.  From 5.30 pm, hot and cold food was served together with wine or beer if desired.  We were looked after very well indeed by the lounge host, Michael Burkhardt, who was always friendly and helpful.  He paid great attention to detail, whether it was clearing away plates, replenishing food items or keeping everything in the Lounge spotlessly clean.  Michael is a tremendous asset to this Hotel - thank you so much for what you did for us.  Based on our experience this year, we are keen to return to the Berlin Marriott Hotel in the near future and would certainly recommend it.

user_reviews.Name: Jonathan Pfister
user_reviews.Description:
AVOID

Hottest weekend of the year. I checked into this hotel in the evening (already around 35 degrees). Late for a dinner reservation, I just dropped my bags in my room and left. When i came back later that evening, I was stunned to find out that the ENTIRE FLOOR i was on had NO AC (every other floor did). When I arrived on check in, the hotel said NOTHING. They happily (greedily) took my money and left. When I inquired, they gave us two fans and said they could check if could move me to another hotel the next morning. We somehow slept that night, so we thought we could manage. But the following night was insane - 3 hours of sleep, no AC fixed, even HOTTER (41 degrees in Berlin), the fans did next to nothing...

If its the hottest weekend of the year (records in Europe) and your AC is broken on any floor, you should notify hotel guests IMMEDIATELY upon arrival and PROACTIVELY arrange other accommodations. This hotel is worse than garbage - if this is how they treat guests, I shudder to imagine how their hygiene and food safety standards are. I'll NEVER stay here again and I would advise everyone coming to Berlin to AVOID.

user_reviews.Name: Nichola McGroarty
user_reviews.Description: The location of this hotel is slap bang in the middle of the hustle and bustle of Berlin - right on the river with bars and restaurants on the doorstep. You also have the train station, tram stop, subway, bus stop and water taxis all within a minute's walk. If you are happy to walk, you have access to all of Berlin's attractions within a 30 minute walk along the side of the river or down one of the main roads that are lined with shops, cafes and restaurants. We flew into Berlin Brandenburg airport and the public transport was easy to navigate to the hotel. We bought a Berlin Welcome Card (zone ABC) which covered the use of public transport for the length of our stay, plus some attractions offer discounts with this. The hotel is modern with an easy check in and check out process. Our flight home was 10pm and the hotel were happy to look after our bags after check out at 12pm. The only issue we had with the hotel is the lifts - there was always one out of order and there was a lengthy wait every time we used them. We couldn't find the stairs to use as an alternative. We were asked before arrival if we wanted to bid for a room upgrade - we bid €6 per night and won this bid so we were upgraded on arrival. I will recommend for anyone visiting Berlin to stay at this hotel. We have absolutely loved Berlin and our stay at the Leonardo Hotel.

user_reviews.Name: Andrea Valacchi
user_reviews.Description:
Great beds, DIY check-in, and stealthy staff! 🧳🚉

Located quite literally right across from the Hauptbahnhof, the Hotel Amano Grand Central is a modern, stylish spot that delivers good quality without blinding you with excessive flash and neon lights.

The Setup: This place is an absolute masterclass in economic efficiency. The human service is reduced to the absolute bare minimum. Want to check in? You are doing it yourself via the screens in the lobby. Get the midnight munchies or need a nightcap? You are hiking down to the reception area to forage for drinks and snacks yourself. 🍫🖥️

The Team: The staff they do have are young, kind, and efficient, there just aren’t very many of them! They act like a highly trained, minimalist special ops team.

The Rooms: The rooms themselves are very good, spotlessly clean, and feature seriously comfortable beds. Exactly what you need after a long day of navigating the city. 🛏️

The Damage: My only real point of friction was the bill. I found the nightly rates to be rather eye-watering for a hotel where you essentially act as your own receptionist! However, to be entirely fair, I most likely just managed to land in Berlin at the absolute wrong time for pricing. 💸

Overall, a highly convenient and comfortable stay, provided you are ready to embrace the self-service lifestyle!

user_reviews.Name: OutaouaisMan
user_reviews.Description: We rented two rooms during July 2026, the first one in early July on the 4th floor when we arrived from the airport, the second time on the 6th floor before leaving the country (end of July).||First off, the hotel is across the street from the main trainstation (Haupbanhoff) so this is super practical and the station is filled with stores (even a small Decathlon!).||On the first occasion in early July, the room was small and I personally found the mattress hard as a rock and found it difficult to sleep and was super uncomfortable. Wife and daughter were ok. The pillow was like a big ball of fuzz and also super uncomfortable. And I don't know what's the deal here but we had a queen bed with two small quilts (one for each of us for my wife and I) rather than a single big one. I felt like a child taking an afternoon snooze with his little blanky. I am not a big or tall person and this quilt was just enough to cover me when I laid on my back but if I turned sideways, there was always a part of me that was not fully covered. Couldn't pull it too close to my face either as my feet would have been unconvered. So not sure why they provide such quilts because they are zero fun to sleep in.||On the other hand, room was clean, very well insulated from outside, our window faced the train station and busy street and we could barely hear any road noise. Washroom was big and clean and water pressure was almost too strong.||On the second occasion (end of July), we were on the 6th floor in a bigger room with a balcony covered with grass and stones and is common to all rooms (one long balcony for 6 rooms)||At first glance coming out of the elevator on the 6th floor, the hallway smelled terrible, like a mix of cigarette and whatever which reminded me an old appartment block and I was scared that it would stink in the room but it did not. Close call.||This room was bigger and also clean. Not sure but I feel like if the mattress and pillow this time were better than the first time but between these two stays (3 weeks apart), we slept on uncomfortable hard mattresses in a camper so perhaps this changed my perception of this new stay on the 6th floor.||Also in this room, the toilet was separated from the shower where the sink is also located which was a bit inconvenient when our adult daughter was in the shower room and wanted her privacy as we could not access the sink (or water).||The balcony access is great and has a pretty good view (writing this review from balcony!) and the only down side is when the neighbor sits outside and smoked as the smoke came our way.||When we arrived in our room, it was our daughter's birthday and they had a small piece of cake in a box with a happy birthday note. That was pretty cool.||In both rooms, we had a little fridge but although both times the cooling fins on the back wall appeared cold, it did not seem to keep anything cold so I think the fridges are kind of useless. Our yoghurt the next morning was room temperature.||Across the street is also a Fellows coffee shop with excellent lattes. The hotel's italian restaurant on the first floor is also very good.||All in all, coming back to Berlin, I would probably seep here again. It wasn't cheap but was the best price we could find that close to the train station and service was good.
